description: This file defines Swagger API schema models for the Hook resource in the Fineract project, including request and response data structures for CRUD operations related to hooks.

classes.name: HookApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes representing API request and response schemas for hook operations.

classes.name: PostHookRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new hook (POST request).

classes.name: PostHookResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after creating a hook.

classes.name: GetHookTemplateResponse
classes.description: Schema for retrieving hook templates and groupings.

classes.name: DeleteHookResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after deleting a hook.

classes.name: PutHookRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating an existing hook.

classes.name: PutHookResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after updating a hook, including potential changes.
